items: `getJSON` requests and parses JSON. Use the failure callback when the request cannot be completed.

blocks.text: With a real local books.json file, its data is logged. A failed request shows a clear message.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not assume a request always succeeds. The file must be served from an allowed address.
